ext.description: Open GB-scale log files in VS Code without freezing. Streamed reads, virtual scrolling, regex and multi-keyword search, level/thread/time filters, repeated-line folding, bookmarks, comments, timeline, and reusable investigation templates.

config.search.debounceMs.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds before the search runs automatically as you type in the search box.
config.collapse.minRepeatCount.descripti: Minimum number of consecutive repetitions before repeated log lines get folded.
config.timeline.samplePoints.description: Number of sample points in the timeline view. Higher values are more precise but take longer to compute.
config.theme.description: Visual theme of the log viewer. You can also switch it temporarily from the Theme option in the viewer's settings panel.
config.theme.enumDescription.0: Default theme (follows the current VS Code theme)
config.level.aliases.description: Aliases for log levels (keys limited to ERROR/WARN/INFO/DEBUG). Standard level words (ERROR/FATAL/SEVERE/WARN/WARNING/INFO/INFORMATION/DEBUG/TRACE/VERBOSE) are always recognized; this table only defines extra aliases, and editing the value replaces the defaults entirely — for example, if "I" means something else in your logs, remove it from the INFO array. Single-character aliases are only recognized right after a timestamp or inside square brackets, never as standalone words, so "I/O" or the letter "I" in message text is not mistaken for a level. Changes take effect after reopening or refreshing the log file.
